definitions.gloss: means; way; measure (to achieve something or deal with a problem)
definitions.explanation: A way or means of doing something, especially of dealing with a difficulty. Often used in the negative: there is no way to do it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{解決|かいけつ}→解決：00136_kaiketsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手立|てだ}て⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: To look for a way to solve it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧{手立|てだ}て⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧、⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{無事|ぶじ}→無事：01602_buji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{祈|いの}る→祈る：01198_inoru⟧しかなかった。
examples.english: With no way of getting in touch, the family could only pray he was safe.

notes:
Close to ⟦{手段|しゅだん}→手段：03219_shudan⟧ and ⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧, but softer and a little more literary; common in the negative.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手立|てだ}て⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: there is no way
- {手立|てだ}て⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{講|こう}じる→講じる：27841_koujiru⟧: to take measures
- ⟦{何|なん}らか→何らか：18430_nanraka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{手立|てだ}て: some means or other

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{手段|しゅだん}→手段：03219_shudan⟧: means, measure; more neutral and businesslike
- ⟦{打|う}つ{手|て}→打つ手：30191_utsute⟧: a move one can still make
